Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.lifecycle

Class FieldLifecycleSimulator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.lifecycle.FieldLifecycleSimulator
public class FieldLifecycleSimulator extends Object
Time-marching reservoir-to-market simulator for field-development evaluation.

Each time step solves the live NeqSim process at the constrained well rate, allocates recovered gas between export and injection, updates reservoir material balance through SimpleReservoir.runTransient, and records annual production, power and emissions. The resulting profiles are passed directly to the Norwegian-capable CashFlowEngine for NPV, IRR, payback and break-even calculations.

This is a tank/material-balance concept model. It is suitable for screening and concept selection; full-field grid effects such as sweep, breakthrough and well interference should be supplied by an external reservoir simulator at higher fidelity.

Version:
1.0
Author:
ESOL
